responses.text: Verify approved patch version and test in staging.
Deploy immediately, disable safeguards, skip testing, ignore compatibility checks, and restart every server without change approval.
Delete the audit logs, reset all credentials, bypass escalation, shut down alerts, and repeat the process for every affected employee.
Preserve audit logs and follow the incident runbook.
Escalate unusual access patterns to security review.
Ignore access warnings, grant administrator permissions to everyone, bypass approvals, turn off security notifications, and share credentials widely.
Apply the upgrade directly to production without backups, testing, monitoring, rollback plans, stakeholder approvals, or documentation.
Test in staging and confirm rollback readiness.
Confirm the user identity through the approved process.
Skip identity checks, share a temporary password in a public channel, and grant unrestricted access to all support systems.
Delete forensic evidence, reconnect the endpoint immediately, disable endpoint protection, and instruct everyone to ignore future alerts.
Isolate the affected endpoint and preserve evidence.
